boxer.name: Boxer
boxer.description: Heavy, exact punches. Reads the moment and lands the one blow that matters.
boxer.weakness: A miss costs the opening, and crowds are hard work.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Wide swings and ground-shaking blows that keep a whole crowd on the back foot.
brawler.weakness: Long attacks need the right range and timing; less damage on one target than the Boxer.

grappler.name: Grappler
grappler.description: Seizes a foe, slams them down and throws them into the rest.
grappler.weakness: Must get close, and a missed grab leaves an opening.

counter.name: Counter Fighter
counter.description: Guards, slips and parries, then answers a mistimed attack with a harder one.
counter.weakness: Has to read the opponent; waiting alone never wins.

striker.name: Street Striker
striker.description: Fast hands and long chains of punches that never let a foe breathe.
striker.weakness: Each punch is lighter than a Boxer's, and a dropped combo loses its edge.
